content:
The **Bug Grenade** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A red and black grenade with yellow bug decals, it deals increased damage against insects. It can also inflict poison damage-over-time (dot) on any enemy caught in the blast radius.

May be given to the player by Scout Leader Treadly for completing Stings and Things.
